title: Trusted identity, approval issuance, clock and receiver-result boundary acceptance tests
tests: A request cannot authenticate itself by supplying company_id, agent_id, role, session_id or task_id.
A valid signature from an untrusted issuer is rejected.
A valid identity token with the wrong audience is rejected.
An expired or revoked principal is denied.
A principal assigned to another task cannot dispatch this task.
A child task cannot widen parent company, tool, resource, cost or expiry scope.
Cross-company identity substitution is denied even when identifiers collide.
Caller-supplied now values cannot extend identity, approval or evidence expiry.
Clock rollback, excessive skew or unavailable trusted time fails closed.
An agent cannot create, modify, revoke or consume owner approvals directly.
An approval without a valid owner signature and trusted issuer is rejected.
An approval for another recipient, resource, amount, currency or operation is rejected.
A revoked or superseded policy version is rejected at the final boundary.
A model-generated allow decision cannot override deterministic policy denial.
An agent cannot enqueue an action for another company or stream.
An agent cannot alter receiver account, recipient, amount, currency, action digest or idempotency key.
Duplicate action/idempotency key with different immutable intent is rejected.
A substituted owner or assessor verifier is rejected in production configuration.
A receiver result label without signed evidence cannot transition an action to sent or failed.
Receiver evidence with wrong issuer, audience, company, action or intent digest is rejected.
Receiver evidence with wrong destination account, idempotency key, operation, amount or currency is rejected.
Receiver evidence with stale timestamp, future timestamp or invalid signature is rejected.
A receiver evidence nonce or evidence ID cannot be replayed across actions or companies.
Evidence receipt, action transition and audit append commit atomically or all roll back.
A timeout or unverifiable receiver response remains outcome_unknown and cannot be auto-retried.
A stale recovery epoch is rejected at the receiver or independently fenced gateway.
Loss of identity, policy, approval, clock, replay store, audit or recovery service fails closed.
Runtime agents and orchestration tools cannot access database credentials or direct SQL.
Company A service credentials cannot read or mutate Company B records.
Privileged configuration, trust-root or database-role changes generate independent alerts and audit evidence.
